scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tvde/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w @tvde/api" "npm run dev -w @tvde/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @tvde/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run dev -w @tvde/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tvde/shared && npm run build -w @tvde/billing && npm run build -w @tvde/bolt && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @tvde/database && npm run build -w @tvde/api && npm run build -w @tvde/web
scripts.db:rls: docker exec -i tvde_postgres psql -U tvde -d tvde < packages/database/prisma/rls.sql
